title: Splunk platform operations
description: Keep Splunk itself healthy before you build anything on top of it. Follows the Monitoring Console default platform alerts: full queues, missing forwarders, near-full disk, licence quota, failed forwarding, TLS expiry, unexpected restarts, and skipped scheduled searches.

requiredData.notes: No add-on needed: every step reads Splunk's own _internal and _introspection data. Searches need a role that can read internal indexes (admin or a custom role with srchIndexesAllowed=_internal;_introspection).

industrySources.control: Monitoring Console default platform alerts (saturated queues, missing forwarders, near-critical disk, licence, search peer not responding)
Indexing triage: saturated queues, full disk, TCP output failures

curationNotes: Skips the Monitoring Console 'Critical System Physical Memory' alert: Splunk documents Linux false positives for it.
Skips search head cluster and indexer cluster UCs: they return nothing on a standalone instance.
UC-13.1.26 (splunkd unexpected restart) is the closest packable stand-in for the Monitoring Console 'search peer not responding' alert.
